reason: Each tab's aria-controls names a panel id that lives in candor-tab-panel's shadow root, so the reference cannot resolve. The panel keeps its own aria-label, so it stays named.

candor-table's .table__scroll, a story <pre> and a candor-article code block overflow with no keyboard access. The article block only overflows with the real fonts loaded, so it shows in CI and not in a worktree Storybook, which falls back to system fonts.
